claim_boundary: Retrospective fixed-mask predictive-discrepancy conditioning on already-open real DEFORM DLO4/DLO5 trajectories. Not fresh confirmation, not a latent physical-state correction, not universal Bayesian superiority. Original frozen parent study remains unchanged.
controls: linear interpolation with zero-discrepancy clamped boundaries
future_information: No future internal-node outcomes; known recorded clamped-node trajectories and two full initialization frames inherited from cached predictions for every arm. No further full-state observations.
posterior_semantics: Source-fitted joint predictive residual covariance across nodes and time. Rod-mode variant projects onto two or four sine modes and adds 5 percent diagonal discrepancy, preserving coordinate marginal variances. This is not simulator-parameter posterior propagation.

primary.metric: equal-DLO mean per-trajectory hidden coordinate RMSE

prior_mean: Cached source/target candidate = DEFORM physics+GCN hybrid plus existing frozen local residual. Same additional source empirical residual mean for all conditioning arms.
raw_loader: Checksum-bound official pickle; float32; transpose (500,3,12) to (500,12,3); clip z to [0.002001,10000]; cached predictions align with frames [2,500).
selection: Leave-one-complete-source-trajectory-out; equal current and +25-frame hidden MSE; equal masks/windows; each family and budget tuned independently; eight source-test trajectories per DLO excluded from original physical training; final fit all eight; no target tuning.
statistics: 10000 paired whole-trajectory bootstrap draws stratified within each DLO; conditional-on-two-objects intervals; windows/nodes/masks are not independent trials.
